method: Custom Node.js closed-loop load generator using real authenticated HTTP and Socket.IO; not k6/Artillery. Fixture prep uses PostgreSQL, warmup excluded. 30s+ each phase: per-user state/5s + market/2s; three concurrent claim waves at 0/12/24s; three concurrent market purchase waves at 0/10/20s. Within a wave groups are staggered over 475ms. No client auto-refresh on socket notification: event transport/load is measured, browser refetch amplification is not. TLS, Internet RTT, asset rendering and login scrypt are outside this localhost benchmark.

database.version: PostgreSQL 17.11 on x86_64-pc-linux-musl, compiled by gcc (Alpine 15.2.0) 15.2.0, 64-bit

environment.additionalLoad: No test suites intentionally running; dev servers may remain idle. Cgroup CPU/memory includes all shared workspace processes.

integrity.checks: Combined participant coins decrease only by fees; water inventory + active listing escrow equals initial water + collected persisted job outputs.
